title: The /themes page is the Theme Kits design: nine kits, launch button, See the kit

source.ref: Design handoff Templates page rebuild.zip; owner, 2026-11-04: make every detail of the templates page match the design; main button launches the 12-minute experience, View kit goes to the theme page

detail: /themes now renders the Theme Kits design converted to the repo's own tokens and Stage surface: hero with the accent picker, a kit bar, nine kit sections (New World, Network, Services, Designer, Bold, Temple, Cyber Witch, Wildheart, Nocturne) with website, Spotlight, Space and email devices, and a closing call to action. The main button goes to freeSpotlightHref('themes', slug), the launch doorway, when LAUNCH_ENTRY_ENABLED is on, and to the Create a Space builder otherwise. 'See the kit' goes to /themes/<theme>; Cyber Witch has none until its theme page lands. Pictures are the design's own, shipped as WebP under public/themes-index. check-tokens gets a scoped exemption for the kit colours.

verify.evidence: Fails on main (no kit-showcase), passes on the branch.
